sentences.he: הוא ממהר כי יש לו פגישה חשובה.
sentences.en: He is rushing because he has an important meeting.

sentences.he: קיבלתי קידום ועכשיו אני מנהל צוות.

alt: I received a promotion and now I manage a team.

sentences.he: הדדליין לפרויקט הזה הוא ביום חמישי.
sentences.en: The deadline for this project is on Thursday.

sentences.he: אני עובד בחברת הייטק כבר חמש שנים.

alt: I've worked at a tech company for five years already.

sentences.he: הוא הגיש קורות חיים לעשר חברות שונות.

alt: The employer offered him a senior role with high pay.

sentences.en: She took vacation because she worked overtime all month.
alt: She took time off because she did extra hours the entire month.

sentences.en: There's a team meeting every Sunday at nine.

tips:
**Work vocabulary in Hebrew**

Job hunting:
- קורות חיים (resume/CV, lit. 'life events')
- ראיון עבודה (job interview)
- משרה (position/job) vs. עבודה (work, more general)

**Office life**: ישיבה (meeting, also 'sitting'), פגישה (meeting, more informal), דוח (report). The plural of פיטורין (layoffs) is always used in plural form, like 'trousers' in English.

**Expressing work conditions**: שעות נוספות (overtime, lit. 'additional hours'), חופשה (vacation/leave), קידום (promotion, from the root ק.ד.מ meaning 'advance').
